No text, no letters, no numerals, no real artist names, no logos, no existing album covers, no recognizable characters, no faces, no watermarks, no UI elements. This is original made-up artwork. Do not draw a website or headings or tint overlays. Export as one wide PNG with genuine alpha transparency around and between the square covers. Landscape composition, requested 2560 x 1440 pixels.
